ticket: T13 — news to globe (audit findings R07/R08)
finding: build_news_payload() ran against the real store and nothing called it. The map drew a hardcoded fabricated dataset and the payload carried one flat string, news_status='FABRICATED PREVIEW', for every surface at once.

seraph/dashboard/globe_payload.py: to_globe() — the one lon/lat->world adapter, identical arithmetic to the renderer's toXYZ
GeometryResolver — asset/place/country/state rules; a record that cannot be placed goes to the review queue, never to a headquarters or centroid
WindowManifest-style transport branch: revision, as_of, sources_health, signals, nodes, edges, sector_aggregates, coverage, limitations
layers origins / mentions / affected / paths / market_diagnostics / preview, each with its own legend and semantics
bounded, deterministic edge visibility with hidden counts
node_detail() — role-scoped click detail computed once, server side
built.seraph/dashboard/console_component/news_: the pure plan() the renderer consumes; cool palette disjoint from the CSRS amber band
built.seraph/dashboard/console_component/index: SERAPH_GLOBE_API.applyNews, a separate THREE group, DOM markers under the same horizon rule as the state labels, and the honest banner
built.seraph/dashboard/console_backend.py: news_branch() replaces the flat news_status; renderer_geometry() reads the mesh vocabulary from the component the browser loads
built.seraph/dashboard/prototype_app.py: the canonical app now passes the news store and registry

D1.what: the mention 'India' resolved to the ENTITY reserve_bank_of_india, because partial matching accepted any substring and 'india' sits inside 'reserve bank of india'
D1.fix: partial matching is now a contiguous whole-token run with a two-token floor (registry._token_subsequence)
D1.after: 'India' -> unknown as an entity, resolved as the place 'in'; 'Reserve Bank', 'RBI' and the full name still resolve to the body

D2.what: 'Mumbai', named in the title of a speech, was recorded as an AFFECTED place. A venue, a dateline and a registered address are indistinguishable to a name matcher
D2.fix: located records are Event.locations with role 'mentioned', not affected, and are drawn in their own dimmer layer whose legend says the role is not established

D3.what: a marker was captioned with a whole press-release headline
D3.fix: labels name the place; the headline is in the click detail

entities.csv: reserve_bank_of_india, cited to an RBI-hosted press release PDF on website.rbi.org.in
source_places.csv: new file: where a SOURCE issues from, curated once with a citation, which is what gives an event its origin without guessing at the prose. All three RBI feeds -> in_mh_mumbai, basis issuing_office
reference_data_curated.note: every coordinate names its gazetteer record; every entity and source row carries a first-party citation. No exposure edge is curated, so the paths layer is legitimately empty.

verified_in_the_real_browser.payload: the real news branch at decision 2026-10-18, 30 RBI stories

observed.markers: India (79.0, 22.0, country) and Mumbai (72.88261, 19.07283, city) drawn on the original globe
observed.palette: news markers cyan 0x5aa9c9 / 0x5c6b78; the fabricated preview markers remain amber and keep their FABRICATED PREVIEW legend. Both layers on screen together
observed.click: the Mumbai marker opens real RBI headlines with their event types and BOTH published_at and first_seen_at
legend: named in the story — role not established
observed.per_surface_status: at the 2020-04-30 archive decision the banner correctly reads FABRICATED PREVIEW for every surface, because no story was first seen yet

tests: tests/test_t13_globe_payload.py (37), tests/test_t13_origin_and_resolution.py (17), tests/js/news_layer_harness.mjs (27 checks); the Python adapter is cross-checked against the renderer's own JavaScript toXYZ under node

browser_acceptance.1_new_source_item_appears_with_stable_id: met — real RBI items with stable event ids reach Signals and the click detail
browser_acceptance.2_foreign_origin_resolves_an_evidenced_p: NOT met — no exposure edge is curated, so no path exists to draw. The paths layer is empty and says so rather than inventing an arc
browser_acceptance.3_domestic_incident_locates_the_site: property held in tests; NOT demonstrated on real data, because no facility is curated yet
browser_acceptance.4_outage_or_retraction_updates_freshness: source coverage is carried and reported; retraction handling is unchanged by this ticket
browser_acceptance.5_missing_geography_stays_unresolved: met — the review queue is the only destination for an unplaceable record, and it is deduplicated by node

not_claimed: the connected globe has not been seen inside a HISTORICAL console run, because no persisted run reaches 2026-10-16 when these stories were first seen. The renderer was driven with the real payload through the component's own API in the real browser; showing it on a current decision needs T08.
three RBI feeds are not world news coverage.
nothing here is a probability of financial loss, and the news layer shares no colour scale with CSRS.
